attributes.name: image alt text policy
attributes.definition: How alt text is provided on images across the page.

values.definition: All or nearly all images carry descriptive alt text, none missing or empty.

values.value: descriptive for meaningful, empty for decorative
values.definition: Meaningful images (hero, logo, people, products) get descriptive alt while decorative images or thumbnails get empty alt.
Most images, even content ones, have empty alt attributes.
Alt text is not addressed or handled differently.

attributes.name: feature section layout
attributes.definition: How feature or content sections arrange images and text.

values.definition: Image and text rows alternate sides.

values.value: full-bleed band alternating with contained sections
values.definition: Full-width photo or colored bands interleave with contained content sections.
Text and images in distinct regions with no overlay, e.g. titles beneath images.

attributes.name: photo background text overlay
attributes.definition: Whether text is placed over a photo background and how the photo is treated.

values.value: dark tinted overlay with light text
values.definition: Photo background is dimmed or tinted/gradient with white text on top.

values.value: no overlay, text separate from image

attributes.name: image embedding method
attributes.definition: How images are included in the page.

values.definition: Images are embedded using img elements.
Photos are set as CSS backgrounds.

attributes.name: image corner and size treatment
attributes.definition: Shape and display size of images.

values.definition: Images cropped to uniform small sizes.
Images displayed at natural full size.
